chapters.1.title: The quantum alphabet
chapters.1.subtitle: Lines, arrows and particles
chapters.1.goals: Recognise electrons, positrons and photons. Discover that a diagram is not a trajectory.
chapters.2.title: The rules of interaction
chapters.2.subtitle: The vertex and charge
chapters.2.goals: Discover the QED vertex and charge conservation. Tell what is allowed from what can actually happen.
chapters.3.title: Interacting particles
chapters.3.subtitle: Exchanges and virtual lines
chapters.3.goals: Combine two vertices, build exchanges and tell internal lines from external ones.
chapters.4.title: Many possibilities
chapters.4.subtitle: One process, several stories
chapters.4.goals: Recognise equivalent diagrams and the different contributions to the same process.
chapters.5.title: The final challenge
chapters.5.subtitle: No step-by-step instructions
chapters.5.goals: Interpret, build and justify solutions on your own.
chapters.6.title: More vertices, more stories
chapters.6.subtitle: Higher order
chapters.6.goals: Build three-vertex processes, count all their contributions and discover how identical bosons combine.
chapters.7.title: Quantum loops
chapters.7.subtitle: Beyond the tree
chapters.7.goals: Recognise and build loops: vacuum polarization, Schwinger's number, light scattering light and Furry's theorem.
